subject: Level-change packet: evidence synthesis, redaction needs, and committee liaison request
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellis Consulting <ellis@ellisconsulting.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Level-change packet: evidence synthesis, redaction needs, and committee liaison request

Team —

I’m opening the packet for Samara Iyer (IC4 → IC5) and want to consolidate next steps before we hit the confidential committee window. Key asks below: quick read and flag if you see any blockers.

1) Evidence synthesis: I attached samara_writeup_v2.docx plus an evidence_matrix.csv that maps artifacts to evaluation criteria (impact, scope, scale, leadership). Please confirm any missing artifacts by EOD Wednesday.

2) Redactions: we should remove direct manager PII, any client-specific contract IDs, and salary figures in the narrative (we’ll put calibrated comp band in a separate sealed appendix). I started a redaction checklist in redaction_notes.md — Tessa, can you own the redaction pass? If you can’t, please nominate a backup.

3) Committee liaison: we usually need someone to advocate the write-up and slot a 10–12 minute advocacy window. Marcus — can you serve as the advocate, or do you prefer to delegate? If you take it, we’ll assume you’ll join the final committee meeting on 5/12 (proposed).

4) Timing: proposed timeline below — let me know conflicts.
  - 5/04 (today): packet opened, initial asks sent (this email)
  - 5/06: redaction pass complete; evidence matrix finalized
  - 5/08: packet finalized + sealed compensation appendix ready
  - 5/12: committee advocacy slot (10–12 mins) + Q&A (5–8 mins)

Links and attachments: Drive folder (shared), attached drafts, and a DocuSign route we use for the sealed annex (link below).

Confidentiality note: This thread contains candidate-level information. Please do not forward outside Redwood.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference

- I’ll coordinate with Lauren on any calibration nuance for the sealed appendix. Lauren — can you check bandwidth for a short comp calibration sync tomorrow?
